svg.title: teacher-student-triangle-loss-arrows-overview
svg.desc: a triangle of three trapezoid network stacks, the proxy student on top and teacher and student at the lower left and right, each with a square A and a circle action below it, joined by a yellow Penalty arrow, a red KL-Div Loss arrow and a blue L1 Loss arrow, with three dashed gradient arrows in the loss colours and rotated Gradient labels beside the stacks, plus two plain observation boxes | source: iclr25-0268_fig1 (iclr25-0268_fig1_p1_vector.svg) | candidate wave3:teacher-student-triangle-loss-arrows-overview | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role
